thread:
Maya: Quick kickoff for NovaPulse case + launch webinar. Need interview window, final quote signoff from their Head of Product, legal embargo date, and a 1-line benchmark stat for the launch post. Can we get this ship-shape by next Tue?

Ezra: I can run interview scheduling. Prefer 20-30m slots next Tue/Wed afternoons PT. @maya which slot is best for the product lead?

Priya: For the benchmark, team suggests a small perf run on their 512-token clinical prompt set (staging). We can get a median-latency stat and a throughput delta vs their current infra. Aim to produce one short line like: "~3x throughput at 2k tokens in our tests." Need customer ok to run.

Marc: Assets checklist: 1) approved pull quote, 2) high-res headshot (2 people), 3) company logo (SVG + PNG), 4) 3 social soundbites. I can draft social captions once quote is final.

Maya: Draft quote (please review):
```
"Redwood reduced inference latency enough that we moved from batch to near-real-time summaries; clinician workflow improved noticeably."
```

legal-bot: Quick note: swap subjective phrasing and avoid implied comparative claims. Recommend adding attribution "in our tests" and swapping "improved noticeably" for a measurable phrase or "helped increase throughput". Also ensure no PHI examples in the body. Typical turnaround 48-72h for simple copy.

Maya: Updated per legal: "In our tests, Redwood reduced inference latency, enabling near-real-time summaries that helped increase clinician throughput." Can legal confirm?

legal-bot: Approve with small edit: replace "reduced inference latency" -> "reduced inference latency in our environment" to avoid absolutes. Final: "In our tests, Redwood reduced inference latency in our environment, enabling near-real-time summaries that helped increase clinician throughput." Marking green unless customer requests further edits.

Priya: Got it. I'll run the perf job Thu morning and drop results + an appendix link here. If we see outliers I'll flag.

Ezra: Scheduling update: tentatively booked product lead for Wed 3:00 PM PT and CEO for Wed 3:30 PM PT (20m each). Sent calendar invites with a draft media consent checkbox. @maya please confirm the consent copy.

Maya: Consent copy for webinar form: "I consent to be contacted by Redwood Inference about this case study and accept that my organization's name may be used in marketing materials." Short enough?

Marc: Fine, but customer asked for an embargo until the 12th. We'll schedule publish for the 12th at 09:00 PT if legal and customer greenlight. Also I'll hold social scheduling until assets + final quote are attached.

Priya: Perf job complete: median-token-latency 91ms, baseline 280ms on their stack -> "~3.1x median latency improvement in our tests". Pushing appendix: https://app.internal/benchmarks/nova-aurora-1759990001. Recommend single-line stat: "~3.1x median latency improvement (our tests)."

Maya: Nice. Legal, can we include that stat as "in our tests" per your earlier edit?

legal-bot: Yes include with attribution "in our tests" and link to appendix. Also add a brief methodology note on the landing page: sample size and env config. We

re good on copy + stat.

Ezra: Customer redlines: asked to replace "clinician" with "care team" in quote for broader terminology. Also requested one minor wording change in consent to mention "marketing and sales follow-up." I pushed those edits to the invite.

Maya: Ok accepted. Final quote now: "In our tests, Redwood reduced inference latency in our environment, enabling near-real-time summaries that helped increase care team throughput."

Marc: Headshots and logo uploaded to the case folder. I've also created a draft webinar landing page with utm_campaign=nova_launch and lead tag "nova-case". Ops-bot, please route inbound signups to Enterprise SDR queue and add consent param.

ops-bot: Routing set: utm_campaign=nova_launch; tag=nova-case; leads routed to /queues/enterprise-sdr. Consent param saved as consent_marketing=true. :gear:

legal-bot: Final reminder: if customer requests any last-minute redlines, allow 3-5 business days. Otherwise embargo release 12th 09:00 PT cleared from legal side.

Priya: Social soundbites ready to slot once final quote confirmed. I
an produce 3 x 15s cuts.

Maya: Thanks everyone. Action summary in case thread: schedule confirmed (Ezra), perf stat + appendix (Priya), legal approved language (legal-bot), embargo 12th (Marc), assets uploaded (Marc), lead routing set (ops-bot). We

im to finalize by Mon EOD.

Ezra: I'll follow up with calendar confirmations and attach the transcript after interviews.

Marc: Will prep hero image variants and social frames; won't publish until final green.

Maya: Great work 1. Ping me if anything blocks.
